details:
Q1: The plan-step crash on pin 6955fe54 almost certainly comes from the Python 3.14 `render_prompt.py` help-string crash, and commit a638db8 already fixes that on this branch. (The issue text says the crash is specific to #5216, but occurrences on binance-blessings#539/#540 contradict that.) How should the remaining scope proceed?
Choices:
A. Treat the remaining scope as fixed by a638db8. The plan records that attribution in a `changelog.d/9266-*.md` note and makes no other code change. As a post-merge check, the next consumer AI Plan run on a release pin that includes a638db8 must pass "Run Codex planning". If it fails, the `RUN_PLAN_CODEX_FAILED` line names the real exception and a new heal generation picks it up. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Do A, and also add a `tests/**` guard that runs `--help` on every argparse-based Python helper that `scripts/run_plan_codex.sh` calls. This catches the same `%` crash elsewhere. If a helper fails the guard, the plan reports it as deferred, because `scripts/` is out of scope.
C. Don't attribute it to a638db8. Defer everything until a consumer run on a newer pin logs the `RUN_PLAN_CODEX_FAILED ... exception=` line, and plan no change in this issue.
